notes.title: 🎉 Out Now: Sugardew Island Kickstarter
notes.content:
[h3]The wait is over! [/h3]
🎉Sugardew Island has officially launched on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rokaplay/sugardew-island-your-cozy-farm-shop?ref=5l8hb3]Kickstarter.[/url] Don't miss your chance to be part of this heartwarming adventure from the very start. Join us now on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rokaplay/sugardew-island-your-cozy-farm-shop?ref=5l8hb3]Kickstarter[/url] and dive into the unique world of Sugardew Island.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rokaplay/sugardew-island-your-cozy-farm-shop?ref=5l8hb3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/f5a13c2f131174a0fb6bbe8bacc3a524d4ac30b7.png[/img][/url]

[previewyoutube=bkn-mfopmXM;full]TRAILER[/previewyoutube]

[h3]Your cozy farm shop[/h3]
Step into a charming world where your shop is the heart of the community. In this cozy game, you'll manage your own farm shop, meticulously selecting goods to sell to the adorable Forest Folk. While caring for your animals and overseeing your farm play a role, your main focus is on enhancing your shop, fulfilling orders from the Harmony Tree, and revitalizing the island. Ready to become the cornerstone of Sugardew Island's revival? Launch your farm shop adventure now and make a lasting impact!

[h3]Early Bird special[/h3]
Early Bird specials are available, but they won't last forever. Secure your exclusive rewards and help bring the enchanting world of Sugardew Island to life. Join our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rokaplay/sugardew-island-your-cozy-farm-shop?ref=5l8hb3]Kickstarter[/url] for all the latest updates and insider info.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843737/a463110f2c0e8f33efc7f650fcf0205f97b38503.png[/img]

Are you interested? Then visit our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rokaplay/sugardew-island-your-cozy-farm-shop?ref=5l8hb3]Kickstarter Campaign[/url] and take a look at unreleased material. We look forward to your support.

Thank you for your support 💓
Team rokaplay

notes.title: 🔮 Coming Soon: Spells & Secrets - Character Creator for Free!
notes.content:
[h2]✨ Dear wizard Students,
[/h2]

The release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1518220?utm_source=CharacterCreator]Spells & Secrets[/url] getting closer but SURPRISE not only Spells & Secret is releasing soon. 
In a few weeks we will release [b]our unique character creator[/b] as a [b]free[/b] version here on Steam.

[b]Prepare for the main game:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1518220?utm_source=CharacterCreator

Prepare your wizard student for the release of Spells & Secrets. Step into our cozy character editor and uncover a wealth of choices, offering dozens of adorable combinations for your character's appearance. From clothing and eye colors to hairstyles and beyond, the possibilities are endless. Craft the magical character of your dreams - there are no limits.
